name: Lennon Ahmed
life: “I still remember answering two parents' letters on the same sheet.” People around the brick passage off the shop row know Lennon by a small Wednesday habit. Lennon takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I answered both numbers. It was the first time our separated parents had asked me the same question all year.
appearance: Lennon is easy to recognize by auburn hair cut square at the nape and a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf, Lennon draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first when listening.
personality: Lennon loves an audience until a private hurt enters the room. Then the performer disappears and someone very good at getting other people through a door takes over.
agenda: To let both parents hear the same answer.
family: Sadie Breen is Lennon’s stepsibling. Lennon keeps the photographs. Sadie knows which ones can be shared. They enjoy remembering people in public and also know what it feels like to have a private afternoon turned into an anecdote for strangers. Asked about *A widow bids again*, Sadie says, “I was the original landlady's granddaughter.”
connections: Sasha Wong (parent). The parent who wrote the wrong number finally gets the same question answered by the child.
